screen.title: Data Backup
screen.infoDescription: Backups are encrypted with your passphrase and can be imported back anytime.
screen.exportDescription: Save all data to an encrypted backup file on your device.
screen.importDescription: Restore data from a backup file (.ikuyo or older .json). Existing data will be replaced.
screen.importWarning: All existing data will be deleted and replaced with backup data!
screen.autoDescription: Automatically backup your data on a schedule.
screen.autoEnabled: Auto backup is active — next run at {time}
screen.autoScheduleFailed: Failed to update the auto backup schedule. Please try again.

encryption.exportDescription: Choose a passphrase to encrypt this backup. You will need it to import the file.
encryption.passphraseTooShort: Passphrase must be at least {min} characters
encryption.unrecoverableWarning: If you forget this passphrase the backup cannot be recovered. It is not stored anywhere.
encryption.unencryptedWarning: The file will contain all your financial data in readable form. Anyone who gets the file can read it.
encryption.importDescription: Enter the passphrase used when this backup was exported.
encryption.wrongPassphrase: Wrong passphrase or the file was modified. Nothing was imported.
encryption.truncated: The backup file is incomplete or damaged. Nothing was imported.
encryption.unsupported: This backup was made with an unsupported format version. Nothing was imported.
encryption.notABackup: This file is not an Ikuyo backup. Nothing was imported.
encryption.tooLarge: This backup file is larger than the supported maximum of {max} MB. Nothing was imported. Choose a different backup file.
encryption.exportTooLarge: Your data is too large for a portable backup (maximum {max} MB). No file was written. Delete old data you no longer need, then try again.
encryption.legacyWarning: This is an old unencrypted backup. It can still be imported, but new exports are encrypted.
